meta.title: Zotero Sync
meta.description: Uploads the documents this conversation produced — Markdown notes, PDFs, Office files — into your local Zotero library through Zotero's built-in connector on 127.0.0.1:23119. No API key and nothing to install inside Zotero. Adds an upload row beside each turn's deliverables, a composer chip, a /zotero command, and a zotero_sync tool. Choose the destination collection, restrict the scope to Markdown only, and unchanged files are skipped instead of duplicated.
